outcome.technical:
Added the status word held (appended to _manifest_vocab.STATUS and the schema's status enum; segment_of files it with pending by its existing default arm). The hold reason rides in blockedReason, so the merge rule for status+blockedReason and the schema key already cover it and no field was added. _manifest_phases.walk_phases emits finding task-held-reason when a held task has no non-blank blockedReason (a blocked task may still lack one). audit-task.py: new verbs hold <id> --reason and release <id> --reason (refuse no/blank reason, terminal, running, already-held, phase ids; release refuses a task not held), journal rows task.hold / task.release carrying the reason; start refuses a held task before readiness and --force; block refuses a held task (would overwrite its reason); unblock names release for a held task instead of the wrong 'start still runs it' advice; parser choices, VERB_FLAGS, dispatch doors and the module usage text carry both verbs. _status_facts.py: comment at the blocked-tasks condition and the ready_tasks docstring state held is outside both; no logic change was needed because ready_tasks reads status == pending and the gate counts byStatus['blocked'] only.
